title: Johnina Nut Jr's Cloth Pack
description: this changes food into cloth or something idk
body:
this replaces food with cloth like this

Apple - Cloth

Golden Apple - Gold Cloth

Enchanted Golden Apple - Enchanted Gold Cloth

Melon - Cloth Melon

Sweet Berries - Cotton Boll (from ss14)

Chorus Fruit - Purple Cloth

Carrot - idk he thought it would be funny

Golden Carrot - same thing but golden

Potato - Cloth Potato

Baked Potato - Burnt Cloth Potato

Poisoned Potato - Greenish-Bluish Cloth Potato

Beetroot - Red Cloth

Dried Kelp - Cloth (what started this mod)

Spider Eye - it's just white now

Bread - Cloth Bread from ss14

Wheat - Fiber

Haybale - Fiber Block

Wheat Plant - all of the saturation is gone now ;P

and a bunch more that i don't wanna name cuz i'm lazy haha ha


All Meats Are Same Textures But Look Like Cloth 


Some Fish Textures Are Unfinished


Mushroom Stew - Cloth in a Bowl

Beetroot Soup - Red Cloth in a Bowl

Rabbit Stew - Darker Red Cloth in a bowl

Suspicious Stew - Blue Cloth in a Bowl


Entity Changes (2 and only 2 forever probably idk)

Zombie - Zombie is now made of CLOTH!!

Spider - Eyes are now made of CLOTH!!


----------------------------------------------------------------------

yeah that's it i just made this mod for fun because my friend asked me to

you know who you are little boy
